summary: Synopsys filed an 8-K disclosing a Cooperation Agreement with activist Elliott Investment Management. Under the agreement, Synopsys immediately expanded its board to add Jesse Cohn, an Elliott partner, effective June 1, 2026, for a term through the 2027 annual meeting. Elliott agreed to customary standstill provisions limiting ownership to 4.9% beneficial and 7.5% aggregate economic exposure, voting commitments, and mutual non-disparagement. The standstill runs at least one year after the agreement date. This is an Activist Campaign where Elliott secured board representation without a proxy fight. Watch for potential strategic initiatives Elliott may push, such as shareholder returns or operational changes.
